title: business opportunities - u.s. embassy in cabo verde
paragraphs: the u.s. embassy in praia seeks to enter into contracts with qualified reliable firms that can provide the necessary personnel, equipment, financial resources and experience needed to perform services required. in order for a company to be considered for government contracts, the company shall be able to meet, satisfy, understand, and comply with the requirements of the solicitation. it will soon be mandated that all businesses entering into a contract or purchase order with the u.s. government will require a dun’s number. please take the time to register your company with dun and bradstreet by following this link to their webpage . find below the contracting opportunities. submit your questions or quotations to praiaprocurement@state.gov . qualified firms interested in submitting an offer must follow the specific instructions in the solicitation that is provided for each opportunity. a – solicitation package – sf1449 – 19cv1025q0001 (pdf 626 kb)

the u.s. embassy in praia seeks to enter into contracts with qualified reliable firms that can provide the necessary personnel, equipment, financial resources and experience needed to perform services required.
in order for a company to be considered for government contracts, the company shall be able to meet, satisfy, understand, and comply with the requirements of the solicitation.

it will soon be mandated that all businesses entering into a contract or purchase order with the u.s. government will require a dun’s number. please take the time to register your company with dun and bradstreet by following this link to their webpage .

find below the contracting opportunities. submit your questions or quotations to praiaprocurement@state.gov . qualified firms interested in submitting an offer must follow the specific instructions in the solicitation that is provided for each opportunity.
